title: Best Things To Do in Boone NC This Weekend
excerpt: Fall has fully arrived in the North Carolina High Country, and this weekend is one of the best times of year to experience everything Boone and the surrounding mountains have to offer. From leaf-peeping drives to local festivals, here's your insider guide to making the most of it.
